mapper.insert: insert into event_acks (house_id, user_id, category, record_id, action, snooze_until, ack_time, remark) values (#{houseId}, #{userId}, #{category}, #{recordId}, #{action}, #{snoozeUntil}, now(), #{remark}) on duplicate key update action = values(action), snooze_until = values(snooze_until), ack_time = now(), remark = values(remark), update_time = now()
mapper.select: select * from event_acks where user_id = #{userId} and house_id = #{houseId} and category = #{category} and record_id = #{recordId} limit 1
select * from event_acks where user_id = #{userId} and house_id = #{houseId} order by id desc
